agent_explanation: Body 0 falls and moves left toward thin vertical wall (x=14,W=0.3,y=2.8,h=5.5). With dt~0.0171 and 5-6 substeps per step the discrete integration steps penetrate the wall corner. Inspect shows distance_to_surface goes 0.245 (step21) ->0.098 (step22) -> -0.051 (step23, within limit) -> -0.2004 (step24, violation), with no bounce/correction applied despite overlapping. Positional correction / impulse for the vertical side/top-corner is not sufficient at this dt, so penetration grows linearly each step. Reducing dt to 0.005 (same steps, geometry, velocities) gives finer substeps and eliminates the penetration, proving numerical resolution / collision handling at this dt-corner interaction is the cause.
